page.overview:
Who is Chabi?

The first time saves her, asks him how much he knows about and the . She gives a and explains that it was made by . She also shares rumors about , such as the fact that he is obsessed with monsters and does research with them.

After has visited the for the first time, notes that has been spotted all over , not just in . She shares stories of his shop popping up out of nowhere when night falls. Because of this, she is beginning to doubt whether she wants to meet him.

When saves again, she might insist that she did not need his help. However, she might thank him for making the situation simpler. She is embarrassed she had to have save her again. Though she has not gotten anywhere in her search for , she has not given up. She swears to find him someday.
